def factor_directional_imbalance_trend_gated(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy['close'].shift(1)
    buy = (df_copy['high'] - prev_close) * df_copy['volume']
    sell = (prev_close - df_copy['low']) * df_copy['volume']
    window = 20
    net = (buy.rolling(window).sum() - sell.rolling(window).sum()) / df_copy['volume'].rolling(window).sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    adx = pd.Series(talib.ADX(df_copy['high'], df_copy['low'], df_copy['close'], timeperiod=50), index=df_copy.index)
    factor = np.where(adx > 25, net, net * 0.5)
    factor = pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=10).mean()
    factor.name = "factor_directional_imbalance_trend_gated"
    return factor
